verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs describe automatic review of every PR with severity-ranked findings, risk/blast-radius tagging to triage volume, org-wide configuration-as-code, and centralized rule enforcement — positioning it explicitly as an at-scale reviewer for AI-generated code across an entire org. This is corroborated by CLI/MCP tooling for agent-authored code review and community confirmation the review bot/CLI is actively used in real workflows. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or case study quantifying review volume/throughput vs human teams, and no dispute evidence but also no hard proof of scale claims beyond vendor docs.
